regime_context: Memory/HBM leads thematic ranks with low durability (0.49) and mixed trend health (r10 -0.138, 'fading' valuation). Cybersecurity holds the second rank, exhibiting strong trend (Hurst 'trend', durability 0.90) and full breadth but flagged as crowded (z=2.12). Several equal-weight sectors (Financials, Energy) show robust trend and breadth without crowding. A number of themes (e.g., Non-AI Software) fail the absolute-trend gate. Rank-IC is effectively zero—these ranks are an attention lens only. The one validated edge is drawdown/shake-out avoidance via the absolute-trend gate, which currently permits the eligible themes.
emerging_watch: Memory/HBM trend fragility: if the theme's durability_bar drops below 0.40 (further deterioration from 0.49) while its absolute-trend gate remains true, it could signal a prospective leadership handoff. Kill-criterion: durability_bar rises above 0.55, indicating stabilization.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible), exhibits high durability (0.90), a clean Hurst 'trend' tag and full constituent breadth (1.0), suggesting sustained participation. The crowding flag (z=2.12) is a sizing caution, not a fade trigger. Our lean is overweight directionally, with the expectation that a durability-higher-than-0.7 floor and breadth >0.7 will persist.
theses.dissent: Crowding can lead to sharp, correlated reversals if capital allocators rotate away, especially given no forward edge from momentum rank.

falsifier.text: durability_bar drops below 0.70 OR breadth falls below 0.70 at any daily close within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Financials (EW) passes the absolute-trend gate with high durability (0.81) and a 'trend' Hurst tag, accompanied by broad constituent participation (breadth 0.882) without crowding. This combination suggests a steady, risk-controlled trend that aligns with the validated drawdown-control edge, even though its cross-sectional momentum rank is mid-pack (9th).
theses.dissent: US Financials are sensitive to interest-rate and credit-cycle surprises; a sudden recession scare could break the trend even if durability holds for a period.

falsifier.text: durability_bar drops below 0.65 on a closing basis within 30 trading days.

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Non-AI Software fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible: false) despite a 'trend' Hurst tag and high breadth (0.857). Since the only validated edge is the gate's ability to cut drawdowns, we lean avoid until theme re-enters eligibility. This is not a fade or short—it simply respects the historical risk-control discipline.
theses.dissent: The trend may be recovering rapidly; breadth suggests internal health, and the gate could turn positive before a moving-average cross is visible. Avoiding may miss an early return recovery.

falsifier.text: Non-AI Software becomes eligible (eligible: true) at any point within 60 trading days.
